title: Evidence inclusion proof
description: head-inclusion-proof.json in an evidence/v1 export: a Merkle inclusion proof (RFC 6962) that the head record is in the log at the head checkpoint. The same shape is embedded as inclusion_proof in attestation.json and bundle-manifest.json. Not expressible here and checked by the verifier: the file is the canonical JSON form; leaf_index is below tree_size; tree_size equals the checkpoint tree_size; audit_path has exactly the length leaf_index and tree_size imply (at most 64 entries) and folds with the leaf hash to the checkpoint root_hash; the file is at most 8 KiB.

audit_path.description: Sibling hashes from the leaf to the root; absent when empty (a tree of one leaf).

digest.description: A SHA-256 digest: the prefix sha256: and 64 lowercase hex characters.
